description_en: Queries the compliance statistics for resources in a specified compliance package within a specified account group
description_zh: 查询指定账号组内的指定合规包中资源的合规统计
kebab_example: aliyun config get-aggregate-resource-compliance-by-pack --compliance-pack-id cp-fdc8626622af00f90000 --aggregator-id ca-f632626622af00790000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAggregateResourceComplianceByPack

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the compliance package.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

ResourceComplianceResult.description_en: The compliance results of the resources in the compliance package
ResourceComplianceResult.description_zh: 合规包中资源的合规结果

CompliancePackId.description_en: The ID of the compliance package

CompliantCount.description_en: The total number of compliant resources
CompliantCount.description_zh: 合规包内的规则评估资源时，评估结果为“合规”的资源总数

IgnoredCount.description_en: The total number of ignored resources
IgnoredCount.description_zh: 合规包内的规则评估资源时，已经设置忽略评估结果的资源总数

InsufficientDataCount.description_en: The total number of resources for which the evaluation data is insufficient
InsufficientDataCount.description_zh: 合规包内的规则评估资源时，评估结果为“无数据”的资源总数

NotApplicableCount.description_en: The total number of resources that are not applicable
NotApplicableCount.description_zh: 合规包内的规则评估资源时，评估结果为“不适用”的资源总数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of resources evaluated by the compliance package
TotalCount.description_zh: 合规包评估的资源总数
